warnings: Multiple biostimulant treatments (T1, T2, T3, T4) with different concentrations and application frequencies
Factorial design with concentration x application frequency factors

Tables contain both target yield data and non-target quality parameters
Treatment codes T1-T4 need careful mapping to actual treatments
Control is clearly identified but multiple active treatments exist

recon.variance_source: Values in tables shown as 'mean±SE' format (e.g., '3.415±0.093a')
recon.control_definition: Plants sprayed with water only (no biostimulant)
recon.treatment_definition: T1: Single spray 0.3%, T2: Single spray 0.5%, T3: Double spray 0.3%, T4: Double spray 0.5% Terra Sorb Complex biostimulant
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Multiple treatment levels could be confused - T1-T4 are all treatments, only 'Control variant' is the true control
recon.sample_size_source: The experiment was established in a randomized block design in four replicates on experimental plots with area of 10m2
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract seed yield (t ha-1) from Table 3. Control is 'Control variant' column. Extract T1, T2, T3, T4 as separate treatment vs control comparisons. Use year-specific data or overall means as appropriate. Values are presented as mean±SE format. Terra Sorb Complex is a protein hydrolysate (amino acid-based) biostimulant.
